# Fred Wright & Gilbert Blythe

- [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) — Comrade of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — fellow committee members assigned to canvass the White Sands road · since v2  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their fundraising canvass, encountering various quirky neighbors including the neat freak Mrs. Theodore White and the overjoyed [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), who donates handsomely following the birth of his son. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P57](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they are presented with gifts before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves for college. The next evening, after feeling discouraged by well-meaning neighbors, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk through the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), where they find a wild apple tree and enjoy a peaceful stroll together.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P7](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0007), [v3 ch.Autumn P32](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0032)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their deep friendship. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) marries [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), after which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, talking about their summer plans and how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is changing.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P16](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0016), [v3 ch.Wedding P19](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0019)_
